page_count.status: Rough estimate, not a verified count

reported_sequence: Sued in a separate debt case in what he recalls as a higher-level court
Received an estimated twenty to forty pages that appeared to be a large worksheet printed across pages
Recalls numbers and headings failing to align across pages
Thinks about one line in the packet concerned him
Recalls opposing counsel being unwilling to navigate the packet to identify and show that line or satisfactorily explain the figures
Understood the court to have accepted the packet as evidence despite the missing explanation
Clarifies that the judge instructed him to subpoena the creator and described that person as the only one able to explain the records
personal_account.reported_expectation: Assumed someone presenting records accepted by the court could locate the relevant entry and explain how it supported the demand
unknowns: Court, jurisdiction, judge, case date, docket, and claimant
Confirmed law firm and whether it represented a separate claimant
Exact number of pages, source file format, headings, and underlying data
Affidavits, witnesses, procedural stage, actual admission ruling, objections, and outcome
Exact wording and scope of the judge's subpoena instruction, including whether it concerned a particular explanation or a general admissibility requirement
Exact relevant entries, their locations, the requested navigation, and the responses to that request
personal_account.evidence_location: Relevant private Daisy case; no case path supplied
personal_account.reported_judicial_instruction: Rigler recalls that the judge said he should have subpoenaed the records' creator and that the creator was the only person who could explain them; no transcript supplied.
personal_account.question_raised: Whether a creator's death or unavailability would invalidate records that remain accepted while further explanation is inaccessible
personal_account.reported_relevant_entries: Tentatively recalls about one line concerning him; neither the count nor the connection has been independently checked
personal_account.reported_printing_appearance: Compares it to a Microsoft Excel worksheet wider and longer than one page printed to PDF across pages; source format and actual printing method are unknown
personal_account.reported_completeness_rationale: Understood inclusion of the whole record as intended completeness; this rationale is his interpretation
personal_account.reported_burden: Describes the process as one-sided because he was directed to obtain the creator while counsel would not locate the relevant line in the packet relied upon

research_limitations: Texas sources are contextual comparisons pending identification of the court and case date
No finding about a particular firm's conduct or the packet's admissibility
No finding of debt validity, deliberate concealment, or case outcome
No general requirement to call the document creator is asserted
